correctness.rationale: The no-four-cycle condition gives the exact 2n+2 terminal-set classification. First-accepted opposite-side events have intersection probability t!n!/((n-d+1)(n+t-1)!), verified by the two largest order statistics and a Beta integral; binomial inclusion-exclusion gives the exact q. A direct earliest-neighbor order certificate and local disjoint-neighborhood counts give uniformity of each mixed-star probability. The resulting two-mass total-variation and mean identities follow algebraically. check.py independently passes all full finite terminal-set checks, exhaustive small vertex-order enumeration and 853 rational model/identity cases. Finite tests are supplemental, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: An infinite, nontrivial regular C4-free missing-edge family has a complete exact graph-independent terminal-set law. The exact uniformity across 2n individual mixed stars despite possible global nontransitivity is a structural probability phenomenon. For fixed d the random greedy process chooses one of two maximum independent sets with probability tending to one, but flat sampling almost surely returns a d+1-set, forcing total variation to one. This is a mathematically motivated and explicit distinction between natural dynamic and equilibrium measures, not merely a routine expected-size computation.
